title: cli-filters-locks-records: Fix events --status/--limit filters, locked read surface, run writes source/header records
description: Bug P1-13 (rolls up 3 sub-issues). (1) vb_cli/src/commands/events.rs:32-33 binds status_filter and limit_filter as `let _status_filter = …; let _limit_filter = limit;` — bound but never used. The events command accepts --status and --limit flags but ignores them. (2) vb_cli/src/commands/inspect.rs:95-101 and events.rs:378-385 have local write_locked_read_surface stubs (a copy of the replay.rs implementation; should be promoted to file_io.rs and shared). (3) vb_cli/src/commands/run.rs:140 → run_compiled_runtime.rs:114 — the `run` command does NOT write a WorkflowSourceRecord or RunHeaderRecord (only `submit` does at submit.rs:91-126). The result: a run started via `vb run` is invisible to `vb inspect` and `vb events`. This bead fixes all three sub-issues.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL apply --status and --limit filters to the events output, never silently ignore them
THE SYSTEM SHALL write a WorkflowSourceRecord and RunHeaderRecord whenever a run is started, regardless of whether the path is submit or run

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user runs `vb events <run-id> --db <path> --status failed --limit 5`
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return at most 5 events, all with status == failed

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user runs `vb run foo.yaml --db <path>`
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL write a WorkflowSourceRecord and a RunHeaderRecord to the journal before executing any step

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user runs `vb inspect <run-id> --db <path>` under lock contention
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL acquire the read lock via the shared write_locked_read_surface helper and succeed

unwanted.condition: IF the user passes --status with a value not in the events status enum
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently default to 'all'; it must return InvalidStatusFilter with the list of valid values
unwanted.because: Operator error must be loud, not silent

unwanted.condition: IF the run path writes the source/header records but the journal commit fails
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT proceed with execution; it must abort with JournalCommitFailed
unwanted.because: Master §68.1: 'Journal entry persisted = step happened' — a failed commit must roll back

preconditions: Run exists in the Fjall journal at --db path (for inspect/events)
Workflow YAML at the supplied path parses to a valid CompiledWorkflow (for run)
postconditions: events --status and --limit are applied to the result set
write_locked_read_surface is defined once in file_io.rs and called from inspect.rs and events.rs (no duplication)
run path writes both WorkflowSourceRecord and RunHeaderRecord before executing
invariants: Every run (whether started via submit or run) has both a WorkflowSourceRecord and a RunHeaderRecord in the journal
Duplicate write_locked_read_surface implementations are eliminated; one canonical version in file_io.rs

happy: events_with_status_filter_returns_only_matching: a run with 10 events (3 failed, 7 succeeded); `vb events <id> --db /tmp/db --status failed` returns exactly 3
events_with_limit_returns_at_most_n: a run with 10 events; `vb events <id> --db /tmp/db --limit 5` returns exactly 5 (most recent first)
run_writes_source_and_header_records: `vb run foo.yaml --db /tmp/db` followed by `vb inspect <id> --db /tmp/db` finds the run
error: events_with_invalid_status_filter_returns_invalid_status: `vb events <id> --db /tmp/db --status bogus` exits 3 with InvalidStatusFilter and the list of valid values
run_with_journal_commit_failure_aborts: a Fjall journal with a read-only filesystem fails the run with JournalCommitFailed
edge: events_with_no_matches_returns_empty: a run with 0 failed events and --status failed returns events: [] (not an error)

files: crates/vb_cli/src/commands/run.rs:140 (the run path that doesn't write source/header)
crates/vb_cli/src/commands/submit.rs:91-126 (the submit path that DOES write source/header; reference to copy)
patterns: Pattern: filter_trace / build_trace in commands_journal (used by submit-style events; pattern to apply for run-path events)
Pattern: write_locked_read_surface in replay.rs (canonical helper; promote to file_io.rs)
questions: Should --limit be applied BEFORE or AFTER --status filter? (Spec: status first, then limit; limit applies to filtered set.)
Does the run path use the same RunId allocation as submit (P0-1 fix)? (Spec: yes, after P0-1 lands.)

security_failures.failure: Operator runs `vb events <id> --status failed` and gets all events (filter ignored), missing the security signal
security_failures.prevention: Filter is applied at the Fjall query level, not as a post-filter

usability_failures.failure: User runs `vb run foo.yaml` and then `vb inspect <id>` and gets 'run not found' because no header was written
usability_failures.prevention: run path writes WorkflowSourceRecord and RunHeaderRecord (P0-1 fix + P1-13)

data_integrity_failures.failure: Two copies of write_locked_read_surface drift (one in inspect.rs, one in events.rs)
data_integrity_failures.prevention: Promote to file_io.rs; remove the duplicates

integration_failures.failure: External monitoring tool depends on a specific filter behavior; the new behavior is non-back-compatible
integration_failures.prevention: Filter behavior is documented in master §33.3; schema version is bumped if needed

phase_0: Read crates/vb_cli/src/commands/replay.rs to find the canonical write_locked_read_surface
phase_2: In events.rs:32-33: replace the let _status_filter / let _limit_filter with actual filter application via commands_journal::build_trace + filter_trace
In file_io.rs: add the canonical write_locked_read_surface function (moved from replay.rs)
In inspect.rs:95-101 and events.rs:378-385: remove the local stubs; call file_io::write_locked_read_surface
In run.rs:140 → run_compiled_runtime.rs:114: when durability != None, call vb_storage::put_workflow_source and vb_storage::put_run_header (same as submit.rs:91-126)
phase_3: Add InvalidStatusFilter to CliError with the list of valid values
phase_4: Run `moon run :test -p vb_cli` and verify all new tests pass
Manual: `vb run foo.yaml --db /tmp/db && vb events <id> --db /tmp/db --status failed --limit 5` should work end-to-end

similar_implementations: submit.rs:91-126 already does this; pattern to copy for the run path
external_references: Master §68.1 Log-First Invariant 1: Journal entry persisted = step happened

key_sections_to_understand: Lines 91-126: how WorkflowSourceRecord and RunHeaderRecord are written
The error handling when the commit fails

apis_that_do_not_exist: There is no file_io::write_locked_read_surface today; this bead promotes it from replay.rs
no_placeholder_values: Do NOT default --status to 'all' when invalid; return the typed error
